text:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up from onboarding call with Zephyr Health — they said embeddings accuracy is fine but the per-route billing toggle is causing confusion and might impact renewal. Flagging as medium risk.

Tom Nguyen: thanks. did they give an example? any logs/screenshots?

Aisha Patel: Yes — on their invoice page, usage spikes list routes but no way to disable embedding per-route. They want simple toggle + clear cost preview. Quote: "we can't explain surges to finance"

Priya Rao: Noted. Is this across dedicated/private or hosted customers?

Aisha Patel: hosted primarily, one dedicated trial. Also asked for an 'estimated cost' tooltip on onboarding flow.

Casey Lin: renewal call next week. can we get a short patch or workaround? maybe a per-route filter in console?

jules_pm: We could ship a UI toggle behind a feature flag + an API param to exclude routes from embedding billing. Low-risk change? Need eng estimate.

redwood-bot: Jira issue created: RW-12847 'Per-route embedding billing toggle + cost preview (onboard)' — assignee: unassigned

Tom Nguyen: I'm around for a quick spike. If we add a query param exclude_routes=[...] and a tooltip, we might have an MVP in 2 sprints. pinging infra for billing impact.

```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model":"rw-embed-1",
  "input": "...",
  "exclude_routes": ["support","billing"]
}
```

Priya Rao: Prioritization: This is customer-health -> P2. If renewal likely affected, escalate to P1. @Casey please confirm renewal risk level.

Casey Lin: Confirming likely medium risk -> risk of churn if not addressed before renewal. I'll ask Zephyr for grace period and capture exact wording for evals. :+1:

Aisha Patel: Action items: Casey to capture exact ask + wording, Tom to spike API param, jules to spec UX (mock), Priya to slot into next roadmap triage. I'll add notes to CS CRM.

Priya Rao: Thanks team. @Tom please update RW-12847 with ETA and minimal UX text. We'll review in triage tomorrow.
